metrics.name: total_amount
metrics.description: Sum of all valid order amounts
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM data

metrics.name: by_region
metrics.description: Revenue and order count per region
metrics.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM data GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

metrics.name: paid_share
metrics.description: Share of orders that are paid
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid) AS paid_orders, COUNT(*) AS all_orders FROM data
